title: V03 Clip 17
shots: But here's the twist. People were still using more phone and internet service every single year.
2001 internet cafe packed with people online, a phone queue, usage counter climbing
Demand for the service went up, while orders for the equipment crashed.
two glass charts: service demand climbs, equipment orders crash
Cisco's sales fell by a quarter, its profit nearly vanished, and it wrote off two point two billion dollars of gear nobody wanted.
Cisco warehouse of unsold routers, bars fall, dumpster, WRITTEN OFF $2.2B
The internet didn't fail. The orders did.
split: a busy online crowd | a silent sales desk with a phone that never rings
That's why the idea that everyone uses AI every day doesn't protect Nvidia.
2026: a crowd chatting with AI on phones, a big chat UI, users counter climbing
People can use more AI, while the buyers buy fewer chips.
AI usage line climbs while the chip-order bars shrink; the chip character waits at an empty dock
